summary: Mass-Driver's microsite for MD System, a 30-style grotesque superfamily (three widths × five weights + italics, plus a variable font), laid out as a light-grey Swiss document: a fixed dashed column grid, numbered sections each with its own sticky running header, orange-red accents. Annotated animated SVG design details, an interactive 3D CSS designspace cube driving a 'Metropolis' sample, a slider-controlled waterfall of 'system'-themed sentences and a hover OpenType card grid. Unlike its Nichrome and Polychrome siblings it is neutral, grid-led and almost colourless.
